title: Multiversal External Game Projection Contract

implementation_scope.purpose: Define a deterministic provider-neutral external-game projection contract for Multiversal Character, Creature, Item, Action, Condition, Encounter, Scene, Vehicle and RuleReference objects while Multiversal remains canonical authority and external VTTs remain clients/projections.
authorized: provider-neutral projection kinds Character, Creature, Item, Action, Condition, Encounter, Scene, Vehicle and RuleReference
opaque canonical source-object references without external-object mappings
deterministic projection field/object ordering and deterministic receipts
explicit projection availability states present, redacted and unsupported
visibility scope, ownership reference, consent requirement and GM-authority requirement as preserved constraints
canonical related-source references without external identifier mapping
not_authorized: vendor selection, ranking, provider-specific schemas or VTI-09 platform commitment
credential use, external account mutation, provider activation, adapter implementation, package publication or external synchronization mutation
canonical game-state mutation or external VTT rules authority
external-object mapping, fingerprints, version negotiation, stale/conflict handling, reconnect, deduplication or tombstones reserved to VTI-03
rules actions, rolls, attacks, checks, powers, initiative, reactions or resolution bridging reserved to VTI-04
durable VTI persistence, a new migration or external synchronization ledger
provider activation, tester distribution, release or deployment

acceptance_red.failure_reason: VTI-02 production contract module was intentionally absent on the acceptance-only head.

diagnostic_hypotheses: The production contract behavior was not reached because the source-governance verifier required the exact phrase no new migration while the document used equivalent wording.

changed_since_previous: VTI-02 contract documentation now preserves the exact no new migration source-governance marker without changing product behavior or scope.
